programme.desc: The Empress Dowager's use of the Boxers to remove the foreign powers from China yields unexpected results. Starring Alexander Fu.

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: Trouble ensues after Ah To (Gordon Liu) marries a Japanese martial artist (Yuka Mizuno) and has a need to prove his martial prowess.

programme.title: Little Hero

programme.title: The New Shaolin Boxers
programme.desc: Alexander Fu stars as a young carriage driver who finds love and encounters peril after he rescues a girl from being harassed by a dangerous group.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black
programme.desc: A young couple's love is put to the test over a tumultuous period of Chinese history. Starring Linda Lin Dai, Kwan Shan.

programme.title: Empress Wu
